name: DrawSplat
description: Whiteboards, video and audio editing, documents, diagrams, and classroom tools. A growing collection built around creating in your browser.

name: Creations
description: Explore the original collection of AI-assisted creations: practical tools, workshop resources, prompt builders, and small experiments worth trying.

name: Contraband
description: Learning rooms built around banned and challenged books. Explore literature, identity, history, and the questions that deserve a conversation.

name: AI & Scholarship Resources
description: Conference sessions, AI guides, assessments, and practical resources for scholarship professionals considering how to use AI responsibly.

name: Postbox
description: Read and search exported email offline. Open EML, MSG, MBOX, and PST files, preview attachments, and organize your archive with portable Windows and Linux downloads.

name: GridSplat
description: A student-friendly spreadsheet for sorting data, using formulas, building charts, and exploring classroom activities.

name: Prospect 47
description: An asteroid-mining and colony-building adventure. Gather resources, build a habitat, and prepare a small world for tomorrow.

name: Dungeon Run
description: Three sawmill foremen and Moxie the standard poodle take on an original LitRPG action dungeon crawler.

name: Suffrage Sojourn
description: An interactive journey through five turning points in voting rights, with primary sources and a teacher mode. Now hosted at mglearn.

name: Difficult Conversations
description: Work through coaching scenarios using the Acknowledge, Reframe, Commit framework. Make space for a more productive next conversation.

name: Coaching with UDL
description: Coaching resources grounded in Universal Design for Learning. Explore ways to support learner variability and more inclusive instruction.

name: Emotional Intelligence
description: A self-assessment for reflecting on emotional intelligence across key domains. Use your profile as a starting point for personal growth.

name: Character Quizzes
description: Playful personality quizzes inspired by familiar fictional characters, beginning with a Winnie the Pooh educator quiz.

name: Website Design Study
description: An experimental TCEA website concept created with AI assistance. A design demonstration, not the official TCEA website.
